edges: Deangelo Vickers is introduced as Michael Scott's replacement in the office.
Michael Scott trains Deangelo Vickers as his replacement.
Andy is designated as the office 'funny guy' by Deangelo.
Michael becomes jealous of Deangelo's popularity with the staff.
Deangelo seeks advice from Michael on how to run a meeting.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Bonnie Stiernberg from Paste rated the episode 8.7 out of 10.
Myles McNutt from A.V. Club gave the episode a C+ rating.
Cindy White from IGN gave the episode a rating of 7.5 out of 10.
Dwight feels snubbed for not being selected as Michael's replacement.
